name: SoftLab
university: University of Modena and Reggio Emilia
address: Via Pietro Vivarelli, 10, 41125 Modena MO, Italy
about: SoftLab (Software Engineering & Data Analysis Laboratory) is a research group at the Department of Engineering "Enzo Ferrari" of the University of Modena and Reggio Emilia. We conduct cutting-edge research at the intersection of data management, machine learning, and natural language processing. Our work spans entity matching, data integration, time series analysis, anomaly detection, and big data analytics, with the goal of advancing both the theoretical foundations and practical applications of data-driven systems.
